script_text: Stop! Gemini, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars in Leo is forming a tense square to your ruling planet Mercury, stirring up friction in your 7th House of Partnerships. Meanwhile, Jupiter in Cancer is casting a supportive sextile to your 3rd House of Communication, offering a clear path through the noise for the clever Air sign. If you're single, the Jupiter sextile is pulling exciting social connections your way, but if you're taken, watch for power struggles in your partnership as Mars stirs the pot. Financially, Jupiter's influence on your 2nd House of Income suggests a sudden opportunity for a side gig, but avoid impulsive spending under the Mars square. Your blessing today is a surprising clarity in a difficult conversation, but avoid making major commitments until the cosmic dust settles. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you can navigate this cosmic shift with confidence.
